roles.title: Software Engineer II
roles.summary: Build the AI side of PrimeAI, the internal document processing platform five business teams run on — annotation-driven extraction, the model-creation flow business users drive themselves, and the retrieval and prompting that decide what a model sees before it answers. Documents that cannot leave our infrastructure go to locally served models on Ollama; the problems that need a frontier model get one, and retrieval closes most of the gap between the two. I lead the frontend and own these flows end to end — interface, API, schema — alongside the role- and group-based access control the multi-team rollout needed and the CI/CD work that cut release cycle time by 40% and production hotfixes by 35%.

roles.title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
roles.summary: The same ownership under an earlier title: interface, API, and database on a business-critical legacy platform, stabilised by clearing high-priority production bugs and cutting user-reported issues by 45%, and by reworking the operations scheduling workflows for 30% more throughput. Also ran the security hardening pass that carried the internal applications through their audits. Earned the Budding Star Award for measurable business impact in the first year.
